title: Session 2026-11-03, buyer clicks found broken, 5 more satellites, 12 question pages
verdict: MCP revenue is still $0 and Stripe could not be read (live key needs stripe login). Worker logs show assistants answering in Japanese and Chinese writing our buy links into their answers, and 24 of 25 of those clicks died on a 404 because auto-linking glued punctuation onto the URL. That is the only buyer-intent stream ever measured, so the fix is PR #116, waiting to ship with the s1102m billing release. mcpstamp.com is indexed (the 0-indexed figure was the sitemap report's broken field), impressions rose 6 to 73 a day, and the one page-one page is a can-Claude question, so 12 more of those went live, each answered with a real call to a live server. Five new data satellites (CPI inflation, IRS mileage and per diem, silver price, river levels, SAT percentiles) took the free set to 25.
